question: A 26-year-old man from India visits the clinic with complaints of feeling tired all the time and experiencing lack of energy for the past couple of weeks. He also complains of weakness and numbness of his lower limbs. He has been strictly vegan since the age of 18, including not consuming eggs and milk. He does not take any vitamin or dietary supplements. Physical examination reveals a smooth, red beefy tongue along with lower extremity sensory and motor deficits. What other finding is most likely to accompany this patient’s condition?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> megaloblastic anemia -> smooth, red beefy tongue -> 80% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> peripheral neuropathy -> lower extremity sensory and motor deficits -> 70% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord -> ataxia -> 60% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> optic nerve involvement -> decreased visual acuity -> 50% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> neuropsychiatric symptoms -> psychiatric symptoms -> 40% CHAIN: Vitamin B12 deficiency -> impaired DNA synthesis -> microcytic anemia -> 80%
analysis: The patient is presenting with symptoms of vitamin B12 deficiency, likely due to his strict vegan diet without supplementation. The smooth, red beefy tongue along with lower extremity sensory and motor deficits are classic signs of vitamin B12 deficiency. Another common finding that may accompany this condition is ataxia, which is a neurological symptom often seen in severe cases of vitamin B12 deficiency.
